_doc: Per-nation TENNIS talent-generation metrics, keyed by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2
code. Lifted from o27 baseball's nation_talent model but re-weighted for
tennis's real talent geography (Spain/France/USA/Italy at the top; a long
developed-Europe + Australasia + South-America middle; everyone else
Two 0-100 ratings (default 50 = tour-neutral when a code is absent):
investment  - top-end funding (national academies, junior ITF/college
pathways, private coaching depth). Drives the elite-talent
spike (chance a generated player is a blue-chip).
grassroots  - breadth of development (clubs, courts, participation).
Drives the average-quality lift applied to EVERY player
Design note (non-major-market floor): codes left OUT of this table fall
back to neutral 50/50, so a player from a small tennis nation still
generates at tour-average with full variance -- the occasional gem can
still emerge anywhere. See generators/nation_talent.py for the math and
the `tennis_global` preset in regions.json for the >=10% rest-of-world
population reserve that keeps those nations on the board.
